h1: Physics Wallah Alternative for Teachers (2026): Teach for a Big Brand, Build Your Own App, or Do Both
dek: Physics Wallah is a coaching brand that hires teachers, not a platform you build on. This guide compares the real options for a JEE or NEET teacher, using only what each side publishes on its own website.
cover_alt: Physics Wallah alternative for teachers: teach for PW, build your own academy and app, or do both, compared fairly
audience: JEE, NEET and school-subject teachers in India weighing a faculty role at a large coaching brand against building their own academy
intro: For a teacher, the real alternative to Physics Wallah is not another company to join but an academy of your own: a website on your own domain and your own Android app (iOS app on Pro), which you build yourself and can often run alongside a teaching role, if your contract allows it. Physics Wallah (PW) is a coaching brand for JEE, NEET and classes 6–12 that hires faculty. It is not software a teacher subscribes to, so the comparison is between three paths: teach for PW, build your own academy, or do both.

Teaching for a big brand has real advantages. It brings students you did not have to find, a set syllabus and batch structure, a team around you and, where it is offered, a regular payout. Your own academy brings something different: a name, a student list and a price that stay with you. Neither is right for everyone.

We are AllCoaching, and we sell the software for the second path, so read this knowing who wrote it. To keep it fair, we only state what PW and the other brands publish on their own websites, checked on 24 Oct 2026, and we say plainly where staying with a big brand is the better choice.

sections.h2: The short answer: three paths, not one switch
sections.html:
A JEE or NEET teacher looking for a Physics Wallah alternative has three real options: keep teaching for a big brand, build an academy of your own, or do both at once. The right one depends on what you want next, not on which is better in general.

{{fig:verdict|Physics Wallah alternative for teachers by need: own brand and app, your own academy on AllCoaching; students supplied and a regular payout, teach for PW; both, teach and build on the side; done-for-you app, an agency|Pick the row that sounds like you. The rest of this guide explains each path.}}

If you already have students who follow you by name, for example from a YouTube physics channel, your own academy usually makes sense sooner. If you are early in your career, a role at a big brand can teach you a great deal while you build on the side.

sections.h2: How we compared teaching for PW with your own academy
sections.html:
We compared the paths on six things a teacher actually lives with, year after year.

  1. Who brings the students: the brand, or you.
  2. Who sets the price students pay for a batch or course.
  3. What you own: your name on the classes, the app, the student list.
  4. How you are paid: a payout set by someone else, or your own sales minus costs.
  5. What it costs to start, in money and in time.
  6. What you must do yourself: marketing, payments, technology.

For Physics Wallah, Unacademy and Vedantu we used only their own websites. Where the website says nothing, we write "not published". That means the brand did not say, not that a term does not exist.

Disclosure: AllCoaching publishes this guide, and we sell academy software, so we have an interest in the answer. Physics Wallah publishes no faculty terms, so there is nothing about pay or ownership we can quote for it. Every outside figure links to an official page and carries the date we checked it (24 Oct 2026). Terms change; check the source before you decide. sections.h2: Why teachers look for a Physics Wallah alternative
sections.html:
Most teachers who search for a Physics Wallah alternative are not unhappy with PW. They want something of their own as well. The reasons usually fall into four groups.

What a big brand like PW does well

PW describes itself as an online and offline coaching brand for JEE, NEET and classes 6–12 offering an "affordable and comprehensive learning experience".[1] For a teacher, a brand like that means students arrive without you running ads, the syllabus and batch calendar are planned, and someone else handles the app, the payments and the support desk. That is a lot of work you do not have to do.

1. A name that stays with you

When you teach inside a big brand, students remember the brand first. Teachers who want their own name on the website, the app and the certificate start looking at their own academy.

2. Setting your own price and batch

Some teachers want to run a small, high-attention NEET biology batch, a Hindi-medium JEE crash course, or a doubt-only programme. On your own academy you decide the price, the size and the schedule.

3. Not waiting for permission

Trying a new test series or a weekend revision class takes minutes when the studio is yours. Inside a large organisation, new ideas go through a process, which is reasonable for them and slower for you.

{{q:Can I teach for PW and run my own academy at the same time?|It depends on your contract, so read it first. Some teaching agreements include exclusivity or non-compete clauses, and some say who owns the lessons and notes you create. PW does not publish its faculty terms, so we cannot tell you what yours says. If a clause is unclear, ask PW in writing or speak to a lawyer. This guide is not legal advice.}}

4. Side batches that have outgrown WhatsApp

Many teachers already run a small batch of their own on the side, stitched together from a live-class app, Google Drive and UPI screenshots. That works for ten students and breaks at fifty.

{{fig:before-after|Before and after for a teacher's side batches: live class on another app, fees on UPI screenshots, notes in Drive, doubts on WhatsApp, tests on Google Forms, compared with one academy login with your own website, app, live classes, checkout and tests|Whichever path you choose, your own batches should live in one place.}}

sections.h2: 5 Physics Wallah alternatives for teachers, compared fairly
sections.html:
Here is each option as it is described by its own website, with what is published, what to check, and who it suits. None of them is right for every teacher.

Our platform · disclosure

1. Your own academy on AllCoaching

Good at
An academy you build yourself, like Shopify for coaching: a website on your own domain, your own Android app (iOS app on Pro), courses, tests, PDF notes, unlimited live classes (YouTube Live, Zoom or the built-in room) and UPI or card checkout, all in one studio.
Published price
0% commission on Growth ₹7,999/month and Pro ₹14,999/month (keep 100% of every sale), or Starter ₹6,999/yr + 10% on sales; GST extra. Pricing[4]
Free trial
7 days, no card needed.
Check
You find your own students. The platform runs the technology, but marketing your academy is your job; the marketplace listing helps discovery but is not a replacement for your own channels.
Best for
JEE, NEET and school-subject teachers who want their own brand and student list, and want to set it up themselves.

2. Keep teaching for Physics Wallah

Good at
A large coaching brand for JEE, NEET and classes 6–12, online and offline, that describes itself as an "affordable and comprehensive learning experience". Students, syllabus and technology come with the role.[1]
Published pay or terms
Not published on pw.live (checked 24 Oct 2026). PW recruits through a careers portal linked from its website; pay and terms come in your offer.
Free trial
Not applicable: you apply for a role, you do not buy a plan.
Check
Exclusivity, who owns the lectures and notes you record, notice period, and whether you may teach elsewhere.
Best for
Teachers who want to focus only on teaching, with students supplied and the business run by someone else.

3. Teach for another edtech brand

Good at
Unacademy calls itself "India's largest online learning platform";[2] Vedantu calls itself "the top choice for LIVE online classes for K1 to K12".[3] Each gives a teacher a large audience under its brand.
Published pay or terms
Unacademy: not published (checked 24 Oct 2026). Vedantu publishes earning claims on its become-a-teacher page, such as "₹ 25,000+ per month @ 4h/day"; these are Vedantu's claims, not a published revenue share.[3]
Check
The same contract questions as PW, plus fixed availability hours where a brand asks for them.
Best for
Teachers who like the big-brand model but want a different exam, schedule or format. See our guides on the Unacademy alternative and the Vedantu alternative.

4. YouTube and WhatsApp only

Good at
Reach. A free YouTube channel is how many Indian teachers build an audience, and WhatsApp groups keep students close.
Published price
Free to start.
Check
There is no checkout, test series, or student list in one place; selling a course means stitching tools together.
Best for
Building an audience before you sell anything. When you are ready, read how to turn a YouTube teaching channel into your own app.

5. Another academy platform or an app agency

Good at
Platforms such as Classplus, Learnyst and Graphy also let a teacher sell under their own name; agencies build an app for you.
Published price
Varies. We compared the published prices of six academy platforms in our Classplus alternatives guide. Agency builds are usually quoted privately.
Check
The yearly price, any fee on sales, whose developer account the app is published under, and who can change it after launch. Our guide to white-label app costs lists the questions.
Best for
Teachers who prefer a done-for-you setup or need a feature a particular platform is known for.

sections.h2: What your own academy costs, and why we cannot compare pay
sections.html:
We cannot put a PW faculty income next to an AllCoaching cost, because Physics Wallah does not publish faculty pay or terms. Any number we wrote for PW would be a guess, so we do not write one. What we can show is what your own academy costs at different sales levels, from our published prices.

  • ₹1 lakh of sales a year: ₹16,999 for the year on Starter (plan price + fee on sales, before GST).
  • ₹3 lakh of sales a year: ₹36,999 for the year on Starter (plan price + fee on sales, before GST).
  • ₹5 lakh of sales a year: ₹56,999 for the year on Starter (plan price + fee on sales, before GST).
  • ₹10 lakh of sales a year: ₹79,990 for the year on Growth paid yearly, at 0% commission (before GST).

Each figure uses whichever plan costs least at that level: Starter ₹6,999 + 10%, or Growth and Pro at 0% commission (₹79,990 and ₹1,49,990 paid yearly, or ₹7,999 and ₹14,999 a month). Starter costs least below about ₹7 lakh of sales; above that, Growth at 0% leaves you more, and every further sale is 100% yours.

An illustrative example: a ₹2,000 NEET crash course sold to 150 students is ₹3 lakh of sales. On Starter, the year costs ₹36,999 before GST, and the rest is yours. The example is illustrative; your price and numbers will differ.

Compare that with the offer you hold or expect, and remember the trade: the brand finds students for you; on your own academy, you find them.

{{cta}}

New teacher with no audience yet

A role at a big brand teaches you to plan a syllabus, teach to camera and handle large batches, with a regular payout where one is offered. Build a small YouTube presence on the side, if your contract allows, so you have an audience when you are ready.

Teacher with a YouTube or Instagram following

Your own academy usually makes sense now. Students already follow you by name, so a website and app under that name turn viewers into paying students. Our guide to online JEE coaching platforms for teachers covers the setup.

Faculty who wants a second income

Do both, carefully. Read your contract, create fresh material, and start with one small product, such as a chapter-wise test series. See how to build a personal brand as an educator.

Offline coaching owner in a tier-2 or tier-3 city

You already have students and a name locally. Your own academy lets the same students revise, take tests and watch recordings at home. Our online NEET coaching platform guide shows how institutes set this up.

faq: Is Physics Wallah a platform where teachers can sell their own courses?

Not that we could find. Physics Wallah describes itself as a coaching brand for JEE, NEET and classes 6–12 and hires faculty through a careers portal; its website (pw.live, checked 24 Oct 2026) does not offer a plan for teachers to sell their own courses.
What is the best Physics Wallah alternative for a teacher who wants their own app?

An academy platform you set up yourself. AllCoaching gives every plan a website on your own domain and your own Android app (iOS app on Pro), from ₹6,999 a year plus a 10% fee on sales (Starter), or at 0% commission on Growth (₹7,999 a month) and Pro (₹14,999 a month), GST extra, after a 7-day free trial. Other platforms and app agencies exist; compare their published prices and who controls the app.
Should I join a big coaching company as faculty or build my own brand?

It depends on your stage. A faculty role brings students, structure and a regular payout where offered; your own brand builds a name and student list that stay with you. Many teachers start with a role and build their own academy on the side, if their contract allows.
How much does Physics Wallah pay its teachers?
Physics Wallah does not publish faculty pay, revenue share or contract terms on its website (checked 24 Oct 2026). You learn them only from an offer letter, so ask for them in writing.
Can I teach for PW and run my own academy at the same time?
It depends on your contract. Read it for exclusivity, non-compete and content-ownership clauses, and ask PW in writing or a lawyer if anything is unclear. This guide is not legal advice.
How much does it cost to have my own app like PW?

On AllCoaching, your own website and Android app (iOS app on Pro) come with every plan: Growth ₹7,999 a month or Pro ₹14,999 a month at 0% commission, or Starter ₹6,999 a year plus a 10% fee, GST extra. At ₹3 lakh of sales a year, the total is ₹36,999 on Starter.
How do students find my academy if I am not famous?

Mostly through your own channels: YouTube, Instagram, WhatsApp and search. AllCoaching also lists your courses on its marketplace app, which helps discovery, but your own content remains the main way students find you.
Can I use my PW lectures on my own academy?
Only if your contract allows it. Lectures and notes made for an employer are often covered by the agreement, so read it first. The safe default is to create fresh material for your own academy.
